title: a page saved under the fetch list's own name
line: a results page saved under the name the fetch list prints for a fetch step (its citation has no record id at the holder) is brought in by collect by that name and sets the run to none the same way a page attached by its own identity does, when its rows fit nobody

steps.say: the page saved in the browser under the list's name, into the download folder
collect brings it in by the name

expect.why: no candidate fits, so the run the page was saved for is none, not found
the step's own log row reads none, the reason in its note
